newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S-E-Banken says dissolves 300 mln skr provisions.
newsitem.headline: S-E-Banken says dissolves 300 mln skr provisions.

text.p: Swedish bank S-E-Banken said on Thursday it had dissolved provisions totalling 300 million crowns set aside for its Luxonen subsidiary which would now be included in its third quarter result.

"The reserves totalling 300 million crowns which the bank accounted for in September 1995 will not be required and will be used entirely in the result for the third quarter of 1996," S-E-Banken said in a statement.
S-E-Banken was the leading creditor to Luxonen, a now defunct assets management company.
The bank's half year results in 1995 were burdened by a 2.7 billion crown credit loss on loan to Luxonen which suffered after ill-timed currency swaps.
